title: The Sealed Scroll
prompt: A tuple is read like a list — but it is SEALED. Predict what happens.

rounds.explain: A tuple is read exactly like a list — scroll[1] is 20. The difference only appears when you try to CHANGE it.

options: an error — a tuple cannot be changed
rounds.explain: A tuple is a sealed scroll. Assigning into it raises an error. Once written, it never changes — that is the whole point of a tuple.
